claims.text: In each of the laboratories analysed alone, regions with action decoding outnumbered regions with stimulus decoding (median ratio 2.4, range 1.7–3.1).
Between-laboratory variance of the action-to-stimulus ratio was 1.8 times the within-laboratory variance (bootstrap 95% CI 1.2–2.6).
Action dominance holds within every laboratory, but its magnitude varies between laboratories more than the hypothesis allowed; the direction is task-general, the size is not.
